synopsis: Chapter 9 identifies Breach, alongside S-TaLiRo and VerifAI, as a tool for failure-seeking search [f6836, f7247]. The glossary explains that these falsification tools search for parameter combinations where a function fails [f16025]. Chapter 9 also lists Bayesian optimisation, surrogate-guided search and evolutionary search, while the glossary places fuzzing, reinforcement-learning adversaries and Adaptive Stress Testing in the same broader family [f7247, f14148]. The supplied facts establish Breach’s role but provide no Breach-specific performance results, configuration guidance or integration details; the stated Scenic integration concerns VerifAI [f6836, f7247, f14148, f16025].
